spans.s: गल् (I) vi. 1P (pp. गलित) 1. To drop, to ooze, to trickle, अविरलगलद्वाभ्यां तन्वीम् Bh.V.ii.21, Am.
; 2. to fall down, to drop down, प्रतोदा जगलुः Rt.xiv.99, xvii.87, R.vii.10, Sis.ix.75; 3. to vanish, to disappear, to be removed, विद्यां प्रमादगलितामिव चिंतयामि Ch.
, R.iii.70, Bt.v.43.With निस्-, to ooze out, to trickle down, R.v.17.With पर्या-, to drop down, Bt.ii.4.With वि-, 1. to drop down; 2. to ooze, to trickle; 3. to disappear.
गल् (II) vt. 1P (pp. गलित) To eat, to swallow.
गल् (III) vt. 10Ā (pp. गालित) 1. To pour out; 2. to filter.
गल m. 1. The throat, the neck, Bhartr.i.64, Am.
; 2. the resin of the Sāla tree; 3. a kind of musical instrument.

गल्ल m. The check, especially that part of it which is near the corners of the mouth; (this word is considered vulgar by rhetoricians. See K.Pr.vii., where the following instance is given- तांबूलभृतगल्लोऽयं भल्लं जल्पति मानुषः).
गल-अंकुर m. a particular disease of the throat.
गल-उद्भव m. the tuft of hair on the neck of a horse.
गल-कंबल m. a bull’s dew-lap.
गल-गंड m. goitre.
गलेगंड m. a kind of bird having a fleshy purse hanging from the throat.
गल-ग्रह m. 1. seizing by the throat, throttling; 2. a kind of disease; 3. name of certain days in the dark fortnight of a month, viz., the 4th, 7th, 8th, 9th, 13th, and the three following days.
गल-ग्रहण n. 1. seizing by the throat, throttling; 2. a kind of disease; 3. name of certain days in the dark fortnight of a month, viz., the 4th, 7th, 8th, 9th, 13th, and the three following days.
गल-चर्मन् n. the gullet.
गल-द्वार n. the mouth.
गल-मेखला f. a necklace.
गल-वार्त a. able to eat much and digest, healthy, e.g. दृश्यंते चैव तीर्थेषु गलवार्तास्तपस्विनः.
गल-व्रत m. a peacock.
गल-शुंडिका f. the uvula.
गल-शुंडी f. swelling of the glands of the neck.
गलस्तनी f. a she-goat.
गलस्तनी f. a she-goat.
गल-हस्त m. 1. seizing by the throat, collaring; 2. an arrow with a crescent-shaped head.
गल-हस्तित a. seized by the throat.
गलक m. 1. The throat, the neck; 2. a kind of fish.
गल्लक m. 1. A wine glass; 2. sapphire.
गलन n. Oozing, trickling, melting, leaking.
गालन n. 1. Straining fluids; 2. fusing, liquefying.
गलंतिका f. 1. A small pitcher; 2. a small water-jar with a hole in the bottom from which the water drops upon an image in worship.
गलंतिका f. 1. A small pitcher; 2. a small water-jar with a hole in the bottom from which the water drops upon an image in worship.
गलि m. A strong but lazy bull, (Cf. गडि), सुखं स्वपिति गौर्गलिः (v.l. for गडिः) K.Pr.x.
गालि f. 1. A curse, an imprecation; 2. abuse, abusive language, ददतु ददतु गालीर्गालिमंतो भवंतो वयमपि तदभावाद्गालिदानेऽसमर्थाः Bhartr.iii.(Misc.)20.
गलित a. (f. ता) 1. Dropped, fallen; 2. melted; 3. emptied, loose; 4. filtered; 5. lost, deprived; 6. decayed, impaired, (pp. of गल् q.v.).
गलित a. (f. ता) 1. Dropped, fallen; 2. melted; 3. emptied, loose; 4. filtered; 5. lost, deprived; 6. decayed, impaired, (pp. of गल् q.v.).
गालित a. (f. ता) 1. Melted; 2. strained; 3. distilled.
गालित a. (f. ता) 1. Melted; 2. strained; 3. distilled.
गलित-कुष्ठ n. advanced and incurable leprosy when the fingers and toes fall off.
गलित-दन्त a. toothless.
गलित-नयन a. one who has lost his eyes, blind.
गलितक m. A kind of dance.
गल्भ् vi. 1Ā (pp. गल्भित) To be bold or confident.With प्र-, to be bold or confident, न मौक्तिकच्छिद्रकरी शलाका प्रगल्भते कर्मणि टंकिकायाः Vikr.Ch.i.16, अभिप्रियतमं प्रजगल्भे Sis.x.18.
गल्भ (I) a. (f. ल्भा) Bold, confident, audacious.
गल्भ (I) a. (f. ल्भा) Bold, confident, audacious.
गल्या f. A multitude of throats.
गल्ल-चातुरी f. a small round pillow to put underneath the cheek.
गल्लर्क m. A vessel for drinking spirituous liquor, एवं बृहति गल्लर्कप्रमाणे कुलेऽहं जातः Mrich.ix.
गल्वर्क m. 1. Crystal; 2. lapis lazuli; 3. a goblet, a vessel for drinking spirituous liquor.
गल्ह् vt. 1Ā (pp. गल्हित) To blame, to censure.
गालव m. 1. The lodhra tree; 2. a kind of ebony; 3. name of a sage, a pupil of Viśvāmitra.
गालोड्य n. The seed of the lotus.
